causal_boundary.not_supported: WorldEvolver evolves episodic and semantic memory online and action trajectories may diverge, so this is not a fixed-memory-identity revalidation ablation.
causal_boundary.supported: A science-domain memory-conditioned foresight system benefits from a receiver-visible abstention gate in the reported ScienceWorld cells while keeping the downstream policy/backbone fixed.

observations.claim: Selective Foresight exposes a predicted observation to the frozen downstream policy only when geometric-mean token confidence q_t exceeds threshold tau; otherwise the agent-visible foresight F_t is empty.
ScienceWorld success with Gemma-4-26B-A4B improves from 46.67 to 52.22 for ReAct and 48.89 to 50.00 for ReflAct when selective foresight is enabled.
ScienceWorld success with GPT-5.4-mini improves from 62.22 to 63.33 for both ReAct and ReflAct when selective foresight is enabled.

protocol_implication: Corroborates proposal-does-not-imply-injection-authority and legal empty-context semantics; confidence calibration belongs to policy revision/freshness rather than permanent memory authority.

source.title: Self-Evolving World Models for LLM Agent Planning
